verdicts.argument: The bid lacks the required details on insulation thickness, thermal conductivity, material type, and standard, which are mandatory per VOB/A §7 Abs.1 and VOB/C §2 Abs.6 §4.2.
The bid does not specify the homogeneity area, soil class, or excavation depth, which are compulsory per the same VOB provisions.
The bid omits the water exposure class, material, and standard for the waterproofing, violating the mandatory VOB requirements.
